li_saas.description: Li-SaaS requires the full Base Control (Parts a-k) but no enhancements.

base_control_requirements.title: Identify Account Types
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Identify and select the following types of information system accounts to support organizational missions/business functions...
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if the organization identifies and selects information system account types.

base_control_requirements.title: Assign Account Managers
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Assign account managers for information system accounts.
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if account managers are assigned for all information system accounts.
base_control_requirements.evidence_request: List of System Owners/Account Managers; Interview notes.

base_control_requirements.title: Establish Group Conditions
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Establish conditions for group and role membership.
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if conditions for group and role membership are established.

base_control_requirements.title: Specify Authorized Users
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Specify authorized users of the information system, group and role membership, and access authorizations.
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if authorized users and privileges are specified for each account.
base_control_requirements.evidence_request: System User List (Active Directory / Okta Export).

base_control_requirements.title: Authorize Creation
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Require approvals by [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] for requests to create information system accounts.
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if approvals are required prior to account creation.
base_control_requirements.evidence_request: Sample of New User Approval Tickets (Jira/ServiceNow).

base_control_requirements.title: Manage Lifecycle
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Create, enable, modify, disable, and remove information system accounts in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined procedures or conditions].
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if accounts are managed in accordance with defined procedures.

base_control_requirements.title: Monitor Usage
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Monitor the use of information system accounts.
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if account usage is monitored.

base_control_requirements.title: Notify on Termination
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Notify account managers when accounts are no longer required, users are terminated or transferred, or individual information system usage or need-to-know changes.
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if account managers are notified within the organization-defined time period.

base_control_requirements.title: Authorize Based on Usage
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Authorize access to the information system based on a valid access authorization, intended system usage, and other attributes as required by the organization.
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if access is authorized based on intended usage.

base_control_requirements.title: Review Accounts
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Review accounts for compliance with account management requirements [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if accounts are reviewed at the defined frequency.

base_control_requirements.title: Reissue Shared Credentials
base_control_requirements.requirement_description: Establish a process for reissuing shared/group account credentials (if deployed) when individuals are removed from the group.
base_control_requirements.assessment_objective: Determine if a process exists for reissuing shared credentials upon member departure.
base_control_requirements.evidence_request: SOP for Shared Accounts; Evidence of password rotation.
